source_assessment.currentness_method: Direct rendered-page inspection of the five exact MZ100 yarn URLs
limitations: The pages are supplier listings on an industry platform, not manufacturer technical specifications, test reports, or certification records.
A company name on a shop page supports the listed seller/source relationship only; it does not prove that the company spun or manufactured the yarn.
Displayed composition and count text is preserved as a platform claim until Human Review and primary supplier evidence are available.
MZ100 numeric yarn IDs are namespace-scoped and must not be joined to another website's numeric IDs without separate identity evidence.

research_records.research_question: How should MZ100 yarn listings be used as evidence without turning platform claims into confirmed master specifications?
research_records.candidate_answer: Use exact URL-scoped listing text as rank-B candidate evidence, preserve platform namespace, and require primary supplier documents or Human Review before specification confirmation.
verified_facts: The five exact yarn pages in this bundle were rendered and read on 2026-08-10.
Each page presents a supplier-shop identity together with yarn name, count text, and composition text.
open_questions: Can the supplier provide a current specification sheet, composition certificate, test report, and lot/version?
How does MZ100 review or validate supplier-entered product data?

research_records.research_question: Does 月兔毛 identify one fixed yarn composition or specification?
research_records.candidate_answer: No fixed composition can be assigned from the name alone; treat 月兔毛 as a non-unique market name and resolve each supplier SKU separately.
verified_facts: MZ100 65002 and 81858 currently use the exact same yarn name 月兔毛.
65002 displays 1/4.5NM and 8%兔毛 81%尼龙 10%腈纶 1%氨纶.
81858 displays 1/12NM and 32%Angora(兔毛) 32%Wool(羊毛) 33%Nylon(尼龙) 3%Spandex(氨纶).
The cached MZ100 supplier dataset contains six records whose names include 月兔毛 across five listed companies.
open_questions: Whether suppliers use 月兔毛 as a shared trade description, independently chosen product name, or licensed series name
Whether any specific 月兔毛 sample supplied to Knit Compass can be tied to one exact supplier SKU and current specification

research_records.research_question: What can be recorded for MZ100 69587 when its page contains multiple count and composition alternatives?
research_records.candidate_answer: Preserve both raw alternatives, leave the single count value and ply fields unset, and do not create an antibacterial property without claim scope or test evidence.
